title: SP1 setup record (M8 / M9)
description: Schema for results/sp1_setup.json. Produced by scripts/measure_setup.sh; consumed by analyze.py. See docs/spec/03-data-model.md §'Setup record' for invariants S-INV-1..2.

schema_version.description: Setup-record schema version. v1 freezes this at 1.

run_id.description: Run identifier — '<epoch_ts>-<short_repo_sha>'. Same convention as other measurement artifacts.

peak_rss_mib.description: Peak resident set size in MiB during setup.

proving_key_bytes.description: M9 — size of proving key on disk in bytes.

verifying_key_bytes.description: M9 — size of verifying key on disk in bytes.

groth16_ceremony_origin.description: Provenance of the Groth16 trusted setup (S-INV-1). Must be non-empty; documents whether the ceremony came from an upstream-trusted run or a locally-reproduced (non-trusted) one.
